title: Cosmic Crystal Ball
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on a metallic stand against a starry green nebula background. Inside, a surreal glowing pink skull emits bright blue lightning that connects to floating test tubes, green orbs, and swirling blue liquid patterns with miniature green mountains.
prompt: A surreal glowing crystal ball on a metallic stand, containing a bright pink skull at its center emitting electric blue lightning bolts that reach floating test tubes and green orbs at the top. Swirling blue liquid with glowing concentric rings and miniature green mountains fill the bottom. Pink dripping liquid runs down the interior glass. Set against a dark green space nebula with stars, vibrant neon colors, highly detailed digital painting.
